 Print SSC announces November exam dates for CGEPT, Annual Departmental Typing Test, Stenographer Skill Test and Delhi Police SI The Staff Selection Commission ( SSC ) has announced the examination dates for several recruitment and departmental examinations scheduled for November 2026. Candidates appearing for these examinations can check the detailed schedule through the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in. According to the official notice, the Coast Guard Enrolled Persons Test (CGEPT) for batches 01/2027 and 02/2027 will be conducted on November 17 and 18, 2026. The Annual Departmental Typing Test (English/Hindi) and Stenographer Skill Test (English/Hindi) Examination, 2025, will take place on November 20 and 21, 2026. Meanwhile, the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) Examination, 2025, Paper 2, is scheduled to be held on November 28, 2026. The selection process for the Sub-Inspector posts in Delhi Police includes Paper 1, Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper 2 and Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Candidates are advised to check the examination schedule carefully and take note of their respective exam dates. To download the SSC November 2026 exam schedule, candidates need to visit the official website at ssc.gov.in. On the homepage, they should click on the examination notice link. A PDF file containing the exam dates will appear on the screen. Candidates can check the schedule, download the notice and take a printout for future reference. Direct link here. For further details and updates regarding the examinations, candidates should visit the official SSC website.
